title: The Solar System
description: A quick mixed quiz: multiple choice and flashcards.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury orbits at about 0.39 AU, the closest of all eight planets.

questions.question: Which planet has the most confirmed moons?
questions.hint: It's famous for something else too.
questions.explanation: Saturn passed Jupiter in 2023 and now has well over 140 confirmed moons.

questions.question: Which of these are **gas giants**? (select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Uranus and Neptune are usually called ice giants.

questions.question: Roughly how long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
questions.explanation: About 8 minutes 20 seconds at an average distance of 150 million km.

questions.question: What is the largest planet in the Solar System?

questions.back: The average distance from Earth to the Sun, about 150 million km.
A region of icy bodies beyond Neptune's orbit. Pluto lives here.

questions.front: Why is Venus hotter than Mercury?
questions.back: Its thick CO₂ atmosphere traps heat (a runaway greenhouse effect), even though it is farther from the Sun.
